name: Mint
hook: Mint will take over everything. Give it its own pot.

steps.title: Always grow in a pot
steps.tip: Its runners spread fast and crowd out other plants, so give mint a pot of its own.

steps.title: Sun to part shade
steps.tip: A balcony with morning sun is ideal; it tolerates partial shade better than most herbs.

steps.title: Keep it moist
steps.tip: Mint likes damp soil. Water when the surface feels dry, and daily in summer heat.

steps.title: Harvest from the top
steps.tip: Snip the top sprigs often, and cut back flowering stems to keep the leaves tender and full.

steps.title: Watch for rust and mites
steps.tip: Orange spots mean mint rust. Remove those shoots fast and throw them away. Hose off spider mites.

outro: Contain it, cut it often, and you'll never run out of mint.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Mentha spicata
